note: Centre matching with conservative crowding flags. This summary is not a calibrated completeness correction.
real_background_note: The same untouched real cutout is reused for each independent frame; its baseline is detected once.
pipeline: Neighbour refined + Simple Analysis per-source photometry
sample: Detection recovery and accepted per-source photometry on the original matching criteria
source_rendering: Intrinsic n=4 profile pixel-integrated with 3x3 Gauss–Legendre quadrature and 128x128 subpixel sampling in the central 9x9 pixels, then convolved with the normalized combined PSF
